entries.topic: Protester avoidance is by route, not chance
originals: How far is far enough from the protesters: does walking past the front?
The three options are the operator's (beat 8): walking straight up always gets?
These risk values are the operator's design and have no source; the wiki?
entries.answer: The outcome depends only on the route. On the way to the bus, the transcript offers two outcomes: 'Go Straight To Bus = Markus avoids the crowd by walking on the opposite side' and 'Run Into Protesters = A protester notices Markus and harasses him'. Watching the protesters ('Watch Protesters', the chant) is a separate optional interaction with no consequence, offered on both passes. The wiki agrees: 'you can avoid them by going around on the right'. Walking straight into them always triggers the harassment, as the benchmark does. Keeping to the far side never does; the benchmark gives it an 8% risk. For listening from nearby, the sources show no risk; the 25% is the operator's own design.
entries.source: /tmp/flowcharts/ch03/w-Shades_Of_Color_(Transcript).txt 'Markus heads for the bus.' tabber: 'Go Straight To Bus' / 'Run Into Protesters' (after line 860); lines 415 and 811 'Watch Protesters'; /tmp/flowcharts/ch03/wiki.txt (chapter page) line 72 '(Or you can avoid them by going around on the right)', line 97.
entries.fix: M00f option 2: remove "risk": 0.08 (the far side never triggers). Option 1: remove "risk": 0.25, or keep it explicitly labelled in adaptationNote as the operator's design overriding the transcript's safe 'Watch Protesters'. Option 0 is unchanged (always noticed).

entries.topic: Does one small public-opinion increase read INDIFFERENT?
originals: Whether public opinion reads Indifferent at this chapter after saving the officer in?
entries.question: In your current playthrough, if Connor saved the wounded cop in The Hostage, does the Shades of Color chart header read PUBLIC OPINION INDIFFERENT, or still SKEPTICAL?
entries.why: The PowerPyx chart shows INDIFFERENT; the wiki starts at Skeptical, and saving the cop is the only possible mover before this chapter. benchmark/scales.mjs H9 predicts Indifferent, and a SKEPTICAL reading would falsify it.

entries.topic: The vendor on the return trip is the same node, with no Carl effect
originals: Hot dog vendor on the return trip?
Staring at the vendor on the way back: the same chart node?
entries.answer: It is the same node. The return-trip tab is 'Stare At Hotdog Vendor (If Not Done Already)', and the chart has one STARE AT HOT DOG VENDOR / HOT DOG VENDOR PUSHES MARKUS pair, so it can happen once on either pass. Carl's comment in The Painter is conditioned only on 'Markus ran into the protesters'. The benchmark offers the node on the way to the shop only, which is a documented omission of a second chance at the same node.
entries.source: /tmp/flowcharts/ch03/w-Shades_Of_Color_(Transcript).txt lines 655-671; en.json MENU.FLOWCHART.01MA HOTDOG / PUSHED (single keys); /tmp/dbt/ch05-full.txt 'IF Markus ran into the protesters in Shades of Color'.

originals: Carl's exact line in The Painter when the clothes are torn, for the?
entries.answer: Carl: 'What happened to your clothes?' Markus: 'Oh, it's nothing… Just some demonstrators in the street, Carl…' Carl: 'What a bunch of idiots… They think they can stop progress by roughing up a few androids? I hope they didn't harm you…' Markus: 'Oh, no, no... They just pushed me around, Carl. I'm fine.' The FACTUAL/REASSURING prompt is cut, so the game has no choice here. The ch05 benchmark plays this exchange from clothesTorn.
entries.source: /tmp/dbt/ch05-full.txt lines 20-32 (CONDITION 'IF Markus ran into the protesters in Shades of Color', CUT prompt FACTUAL/REASSURING).

entries.topic: The push and the yell need Markus to stay put
originals: Whether the push and the yell really need Markus to stay put the?
entries.answer: Both need it. The push is '(If Markus Keeps Standing By Him)'. The yell needs him to 'stay there and watch him' (wiki flowchart list) and is the 'Disturb Preacher' follow-on to 'Observe Preacher'. The benchmark offers each follow-on only on the visit right after its first step.
entries.source: /tmp/flowcharts/ch03/w-Shades_Of_Color_(Transcript).txt line 665 '(If Markus Keeps Standing By Him)', lines 277-287; /tmp/flowcharts/ch03/wiki.txt (chapter page) line 41 'Preacher yells at Markus - stay there and watch him'.

entries.topic: The preacher, his sermon and his yell
originals: Changed from the operator's notes to match the wiki: the speaker is a?
entries.answer: The speaker is the preacher by the arcade entrance. His sermon includes 'the slaves are becoming the master!' and 'they care for our old!', and the yell is 'You are the one by whom The Evil will come! You are the one who will destroy Detroit!'. Afterwards 'The preacher continues ranting.' The benchmark quotes these lines.

entries.topic: The preacher is passed only before the shop
originals: Whether the preacher can still be watched after collecting the package (the chart?
entries.answer: Only before the shop. The wiki puts him 'to the right-hand side of the entrance' that Markus passes before going in. The transcript's return-trip interactions (vendor, busker 'Can Happen Again', homeless man, display-window couple, protesters) do not include him. The chart's placement is layout, not order.
